title: Styling assistant
intro: Ask me about outfits, or send a photo: I can review what you're wearing, add a garment to your wardrobe or check something you're thinking of buying. When you mention a new measurement or preference I save it to your profile. Deleting a report waits for your confirmation; everything else can be undone.
placeholder: e.g. A friend's wedding tomorrow, and it's getting cold
